name: Skins help
description: The Skins plugin's Help mode entries (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Skins
entries.text: Every skin in one gallery. Tap one to preview it live, then Use skin to switch the scope you picked: the whole hub, this app, one screen or one plugin.

entries.title: Where
entries.text: Which level the buttons change: the whole hub, this app, one screen or one plugin. A smaller scope wins over a bigger one.

entries.title: Desktop or phone
entries.text: Shows the preview at desktop or phone width. Nothing is saved until you tap Use skin.

entries.title: Use skin
entries.text: Switches the picked scope to the skin you are previewing. Undo puts it back.

entries.title: Back to skin
entries.text: Drops every change made on top of the skin at this scope, so it shows as it ships. The skin stays.

entries.title: Restore to Default
entries.text: Puts this scope back to its default: no hub-wide skin, the app's saved look, or the screen / plugin following its parent. Undo puts it back.

entries.title: Undo
entries.text: Takes back the last Use, Back or Restore. Only one step is kept.

entries.title: Skins settings
entries.text: Whether the banner chip shows, the default scope, how long Undo stays offered and the preview size; install and uninstall. Settings → Plugins → Skins.

entries.title: Open Skins from anywhere
entries.text: console_open {kind: screen, target: skin-gallery} opens the gallery; add focus skin/<id> to pick a skin, scope/<scope> (hub, app, ui:<view>, plugin:<id>) to open the scope picker there, or preview/<id>?view=phone for the phone preview. The hash form is #/skin-gallery?skin=<id>&scope=<scope>&view=phone. GET /api/plugins/skin-gallery/open returns the link.

entries.title: Gallery
entries.text: Every skin: its icon pack, how many asset types it covers, and where it is in use. Tap one to preview it.

entries.title: Or type its id
entries.text: Type the id of a screen or plugin when it is not in the list above. The skin you pick applies to that scope only.

entries.title: Desktop
entries.text: Previews the selected skin at desktop width.

entries.title: Phone
entries.text: Previews the selected skin at phone width.

entries.title: Covers of asset types
entries.text: How many of the asset types this skin covers and how many style parts it brings. A skin that covers fewer types falls back to the app defaults for the rest.

entries.title: Show the skin chip on the banner
entries.text: Shows a chip on the banner with the skin in force on the screen in front, with one-tap Use, Back and Undo. Takes effect straight away and is remembered.

entries.title: Default scope
entries.text: Where the banner chip, voice commands and the gallery switch skins when no scope is named: the whole hub, this app, the screen in front or the plugin in front.

entries.title: Undo window
entries.text: How long the snackbar offers Undo after a skin change. Undo on the toolbar stays available until the next change.

entries.title: Desktop and phone
entries.text: Previews the selected skin at desktop and phone width side by side.

entries.title: Change skin here
entries.text: Opens the Skins gallery scoped to the screen in front, so the skin you pick applies to this screen only.

entries.title: Change skin for this plugin
entries.text: Opens the Skins gallery scoped to the plugin in front, so the skin you pick applies to that plugin only.

entries.title: Skins
entries.text: Settings for the Skins plugin: the banner chip, the default scope, the undo window and the preview viewport.

entries.title: Skin chip
entries.text: The skin in force on the screen in front, with one-tap Use, Back to skin and Undo. Right-click or long-press it for its settings.

steps.say: Pick where to switch: the hub, this app, one screen or one plugin.
Tap a skin to preview it, on desktop or phone width.
Use skin switches it. Undo takes it back.
